composition_rules: Select a small number of compatible ingredients; no task must use the entire catalog.
Source and accepted branch facts constrain the combination; novelty does not override them silently.
Close continuation preserves source genre and style and may leave a sampled trope or situation unused.
Expose required creative choices and constraints in the brief or accessible project files.
A sampled continuity challenge must fit the source or a visibly authorized branch change.
Book candidates are acquisition ideas, never automatically admitted training sources.
Judge realized diversity and narrative consequences after generation, not labels alone.
